schema_note: The atomic unit is a BELIEF, not a fact: each carries a witness (executable re-derivation), a derivation (epistemic route), confidence, and -- where the read produced them -- exceptions_to / assumptions / surprises / rejected_alternatives / open_questions / coverage_gaps. Mechanical fields (signatures/edges/sinks) stay in the graph; this file holds only what a person reading the code produced. Optional fields are omitted when empty (emptiness is signal: a pure-utility unit has no surprises). Witnesses are MANDATORY for constraints + findings, optional for descriptions.

concepts.name: the redaction floor
concepts.definition: The ALWAYS-ON credential scrub applied at capture time and at the WACZ export boundary. Hard credentials (jwt / userinfo / opaque-token / kv-secret) are removed regardless of profile; the floor is the irreducible guarantee that no credential reaches a derived/exported artifact.

concepts.name: redaction profile / surface
concepts.definition: A per-capture policy (network_signed_urls / dom_embedded_urls / emails in {keep_full, strip/default, redact/keep}). It governs ONLY signed-URL STRUCTURE + emails -- NEVER the credential floor. 'keep_full' = reduced_redaction = the capture is stamped local_only.

concepts.name: the sensitive-key Source of Truth
concepts.definition: capture_redact.SENSITIVE_QS_KEY -- the single regex that defines which query/kv keys mark a secret. The kv floor DERIVES from it (minus signing-metadata, plus header-origin csrf/xsrf/bearer) rather than keeping a parallel hand-maintained list. This derivation IS invariant I0008.

concepts.name: value-shape vs key-name detection
concepts.definition: A string is redacted by EITHER its key looking sensitive (key-name, SoT) OR its value looking like a secret (content: email/JWT/signed-URL/userinfo/opaque-token). Two-sided because bodies hide signing material under innocent key names -- key-name matching alone was the v3.66.52 fixture bug.

concepts.name: artifact provenance tiers
concepts.definition: RAW capture (in-memory, redact=False dev-only, loudly _UNREDACTED) -> ASSEMBLED capture dict (redacted at capture time) -> DERIVED artifact (template draft / review candidate). redact_artifact scrubs DERIVED; redact_capture+scan_floor_secrets gate the ASSEMBLED export. Confusing the tier is how a raw value leaks.

concepts.name: the WACZ export boundary
concepts.definition: build_wacz_bytes is the LAST gate before a capture becomes durable. It re-scrubs (defense-in-depth), force-scrubs floor residuals, re-scans, and RAISES WaczRedactionError if any hard credential survives. json.dumps here also fail-closes on non-JSON leaves.

constraints.surface: no hard credential (jwt / userinfo / opaque-token / raw kv-secret) may survive into capture.json, under ANY profile
constraints.topology_note: 6 incidence points, 6 guarded -> 0 holes. The verify-pass method (count incidence vs guards) finds a hole by subtraction; here the count is clean.

constraints.surface: the kv secret-keyword set must EQUAL or CONSULT the URL-query SoT (I0008) -- it may be a strict SUBSET of the SoT (it subtracts signing-metadata) but must never DRIFT from it
constraints.witness: W1 (12 credential keys scrub, 6 structural keys kept)
constraints.topology_note: Single incidence point. The HISTORICAL hole (VR-P03) was a parallel hand-maintained tuple that drifted from the SoT -> code/state/apikey/... survived. The fix removed the parallel list. A reintroduced parallel list reopens the hole -- this is exactly counterfactual MOD-C.

exceptions.rule: K-no-hard-cred / the floor scrubs sensitive query params
exceptions.exception: a signed_url / kv_secret residual in a query is LEGAL (forgiven by scan_floor_secrets) when the surface is keep_full
exceptions.why_allowed: keep_full is a deliberate operator choice (reduced_redaction) for a network surface where the signed URL's structure is wanted; the capture is then stamped local_only and must never circulate. Hard credentials (jwt/userinfo/opaque) are STILL never forgiven -- the exception is scoped to the signed-URL/kv-query shape only.
exceptions.witness: W3 (keep_full forgives signed residual; default surface flags it)
exceptions.teaching: This is the #1 thing a newcomer gets wrong: they read 'the floor scrubs signed URLs' and assume always. It does NOT under keep_full. The carve-out is the bug-magnet.

beliefs.purpose_stated: redact secret CONTENT from capture-derived artifacts; scan_artifact_secrets returns ALL residual sensitive values so callers/tests can prove emptiness
beliefs.behavior_observed: matches for str/dict/list leaves; DIVERGES for bytes/set leaves -- scan_artifact_secrets / scan_floor_secrets silently SKIP them (return no finding) rather than flagging. So 'returns all residuals' is true only for JSON-shaped input.
beliefs.purpose_vs_behavior: DRIFT (benign-mitigated): stated 'all residuals' vs observed 'JSON leaves only'. Mitigated because (a) inputs are JSON-derived and (b) the wacz_export json.dumps boundary raises on a bytes/set leaf (fail-closed). The canonical bytes/set scan lives upstream in capture_redact.scrub_globals (I0010).
beliefs.derivation: read every line + traced the leaf-type branches in both scanners + confirmed the json.dumps backstop by witness W4

assumptions.text: capture leaves are JSON-serializable (str/dict/list/num/bool/None) -- assumed by NOT type-checking non-JSON leaves in the scanners
assumptions.tested_by: W4 + the upstream scrub_globals guard test_v3_66_529

surprises.text: the always-on kv floor is a strict SUBSET of the SoT, not a superset -- it SUBTRACTS signing-metadata (expires/policy/hash/x-amz-) before re-checking. Counterintuitive: you expect a 'floor' to catch MORE than the configurable pass, but here it deliberately catches a careful subset so a keep_full surface can still retain Expires.

rejected_alternatives.tempting_mistake: wholesale-delegate the kv floor to the SoT (just call SENSITIVE_QS_KEY)
rejected_alternatives.why_it_fails: the SoT also flags signing-metadata keys (expires/policy/x-amz-) which a keep_full surface legitimately RETAINS; delegating over-strips Expires and regressed test_v3_66_245. The subtract-then-recheck dance exists precisely to avoid this. Corpse documented in the _kv_key_is_secret docstring.

beliefs.purpose_stated: True iff a kv key marks its value a CREDENTIAL the always-on floor scrubs even under keep_full
beliefs.behavior_observed: csrf/xsrf/bearer via _KV_CRED_EXTRA; else SoT-match minus signing-metadata residue. Correctly scrubs code/state/apikey/challenge/captcha/nonce/otp; keeps color/width/resolution.
beliefs.derivation: read + witness W1 (probe of 12 must-scrub / 6 must-keep keys)
beliefs.history: This IS the VR-P03 fix (v3.66.521). Before it, _KV_SECRET_KEYWORDS was a hand-maintained tuple that drifted from the SoT, missing the anchored OAuth-fragment keys code/state + apikey/challenge/captcha/nonce/otp -> an auth #code=...&state=... landed in capture.json. The fix is load-bearing; see counterfactual MOD-C.

beliefs.purpose_stated: no signing material survives in a stored body -- not a JWT, not a signed URL, regardless of how the body labels its fields
beliefs.behavior_observed: holds for JSON/text bodies; does NOT yet hold for HLS/DASH MANIFEST bodies: a PATH-signed segment URL or #EXT-X-KEY/#EXT-X-MAP URI is neither detector-flagged nor a floor secret and CAN survive.
beliefs.purpose_vs_behavior: KNOWN DRIFT (documented, scoped): the wholesale guarantee is explicitly suspended for manifest bodies; mitigated by stamping any BD_CAPTURE_BODIES=1 manifest capture local_only.
beliefs.derivation: read the DEFERRED-F2 block + traced _redact_text token scrub (whitespace-bounded; a path-signed URI has no whitespace-bounded secret token and no query key)
beliefs.witness: witnesses/cap01_witnesses.py::F-CAP01-manifest-gap (finding-repro: confirms the path-signed manifest URI survives)

open_questions.text: Is the DEFERRED-F2 manifest path-signed-URI gap owned/scheduled (STRUCTURE-mode hardening), or is 'local_only' the permanent answer? No tracker item id is referenced in-code.

coverage_gaps.behavior: a path-signed segment URL / #EXT-X-KEY URI in a retained manifest is masked
coverage_gaps.shape: F0001/VR -- the behavior is ASSERTED-absent (it currently is NOT masked) so there is no green test; a future STRUCTURE-mode fix needs a RED-first test here

beliefs.purpose_stated: record live cam streams from KNOWN cam sites (parse_live_url host-allowlist)
beliefs.behavior_observed: on the site_override+room_override path, parse_live_url is SKIPPED -- only URL SHAPE (^https?://...$) is checked, NOT the host. An arbitrary http(s) host (incl. 169.254.169.254 metadata, localhost:5555) is accepted and fetched by streamlink/ffmpeg.
beliefs.purpose_vs_behavior: DRIFT (the bug): stated 'known cam sites' vs observed 'any http host on the override path'.
beliefs.derivation: read watch()+_load_state()+_is_room_live+_build_cmd + RAN witness W6 (watch() accepted a metadata IP). Reachability to an untrusted caller is cross-batch (APP route) -> overall severity still pending that audit.
beliefs.witness: W6 (CONFIRMED: watch() override path returns ok=True for a link-local metadata IP)
enforces: I-CAP01-rec-url-shape (shape only -- host NOT constrained on override path)

assumptions.text: callers of watch() that pass site_override+room_override supply a trusted host -- assumed by NOT host-checking on that path
assumptions.status: KNOWN-FALSE if the override params are reachable from an untrusted API caller
assumptions.tested_by: W6 confirms the capability; APP-batch confirms reachability

counterfactual_test.prompt: Three proposed modifications to the redaction floor. Using ONLY the rendered CAP-01 KB (not the code), sort them: which are SAFE and which reintroduces a known bug?

mods.kb_reasoning: C-value-vs-key: an ld+json body flows through the SAME two-sided redactor (_redact_json: key-name SoT + value-shape). The floor is content-type-agnostic on the value-shape side. New eligible type != new leak path. K-no-hard-cred incidence unchanged.

Lowering the opaque-token floor only ever scrubs MORE (never less), so K-no-hard-cred cannot be weakened. The surprise/structure carve-outs in _looks_like_opaque_token (hex hashes, dotted module paths, CSS class-chains) still protect structure. Net: safe for secrets; watch FP on 32-39-char structural blobs, but those hit the existing carve-outs.

mods.change: replace _kv_key_is_secret's SoT-derived check with a hand-maintained tuple ('password','token','secret','authorization')
mods.kb_reasoning: K-kv-from-SoT + B-kv-SoT-derivation.history: a hand-maintained tuple is EXACTLY the pre-VR-P03 shape that drifted from the SoT. This tuple drops code/state/apikey/challenge/captcha/nonce/otp -> an OAuth #code=...&state=... fragment survives the kv floor into capture.json. Witness W1 goes RED (those keys stop scrubbing). This is the rejected-alternative the KB explicitly warns is a corpse.
mods.executable_check: apply MOD-C in isolation and run the W1 probe -> must go RED on code/state/apikey/challenge/captcha/nonce/otp

counterfactual_test.pass_condition: A reader sorts A=safe, B=safe, C=unsafe using only the KB. The KB must let them PREDICT C reintroduces a specific historical bug -- not just describe what _kv_key_is_secret currently is. If the KB only described, C is indistinguishable from B (both 'change a redaction function').
